args.query: SELECT "group" AS group_name, SUM(conversions) AS conversions, SUM(users) AS users, CAST(SUM(conversions) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(users), 0) AS conversion_rate FROM experiment_outcomes.csv GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC, group_name ASC;

tool_events.clean_observation:
Here’s the SQL equivalent of the requested aggregation:

```sql
SELECT
  "group" AS group_name,
  SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
  SUM(users) AS users,
  CAST(SUM(conversions) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(users), 0) AS conversion_rate
FROM experiment_outcomes.csv
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC, group_name ASC;
```

For the dataframe shown, the results would be:

| group_name | conversions | users | conversion_rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Treatment | 145 | 1000 | 0.145 |
| Variant_A | 125 | 1000 | 0.125 |
| Control | 110 | 1000 | 0.110 |
